summary: Keenova Therapeutics plc filed an 8-K with Items 7.01, 8.01, and 9.01 to announce positive Phase 3 clinical trial results for XIAFLEX in treating plantar fibromatosis. The trial met its primary endpoint of pain reduction and key secondary endpoints. No special-situation transaction (acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, etc.) is described. The filing is a routine disclosure of clinical data under Regulation FD and Other Events, not a corporate event warranting a special-situations category.
